LONDON SCHOOL OF CAPOEIRA

Classes, Beginners' Courses & Memberships

Training • Music • Culture • Community

Welcome to the London School of Capoeira!

Whether you are completely new to Capoeira or already have experience, we offer a structured training programme to help you develop your skills, fitness, musicality and understanding of this unique Brazilian art form.

All classes are led by Masters Silvia and Marcos, or by London School of Capoeira instructors who have been trained and are guided by the Masters. This ensures consistency in our teaching approach and maintains a high standard of instruction across all classes.

1. CLASSES & WEEKLY TIMETABLE

We offer a variety of classes throughout the week, covering Capoeira techniques, physical conditioning, music and traditional roda practice.

MONDAY, 7:00–8:30 PM

Extended Regular Capoeira Class

Suitable for students of all levels.

An extended training session designed to develop your technique, strength, coordination and overall Capoeira game.

The session includes:

  • Warm-up and mobility

  • Conditioning and strength

  • Independent training

  • Partner training

  • Roda practice

  • Acrobatic movements

The longer format provides additional time to refine techniques, develop combinations and deepen your Capoeira practice.

TUESDAY, 7:00–8:00 PM

Beginners' Capoeira Course & Intermediate Training

Both groups train separately during this session.

Beginners' Course

Designed for complete beginners and students who wish to strengthen their foundations.

The structured course covers:

  • Basic Capoeira movements

  • London School of Capoeira fundamentals

  • Essential techniques and coordination

  • Introduction to Capoeira music and culture

No previous experience is required.

The Beginners' Course is a separate, one-off course and must be purchased independently of the regular memberships.

Intermediate Training

A dedicated training session for intermediate students to continue developing their techniques, combinations and overall Capoeira skills.

TUESDAY, 8:00–9:00 PM

Capoeira Music

Develop your musical skills and understanding of the musical traditions of Capoeira.

During this session, students will:

  • Learn the four core instruments used in Capoeira

  • Develop their Berimbau playing

  • Practise rhythms and traditional songs

  • Improve ensemble playing and musical coordination

Students who are completely new to the Berimbau are encouraged to attend our separate beginner Berimbau courses, organised periodically.

WEDNESDAY, 7:00–8:30 PM

Extended Regular Capoeira Class

Suitable for students of all levels.

A second extended training session, providing another opportunity to develop your Capoeira.

The session includes:

  • Warm-up and mobility

  • Conditioning and strength

  • Independent training

  • Partner training

  • Roda practice

  • Acrobatic movements

Extra training time allows you to refine techniques, build combinations and improve your overall game.

THURSDAY, 7:00–8:00 PM

Beginners' Capoeira Course & Intermediate Training

A second weekly opportunity for beginners to develop their foundations and for intermediate students to continue progressing.

Both groups train separately.

Beginners' Course

Students continue working on:

  • Basic Capoeira movements

  • London School of Capoeira fundamentals

  • Essential techniques and coordination

  • Introduction to Capoeira music and culture

Intermediate Training

Dedicated training to develop technique, coordination, combinations and confidence in the game.

THURSDAY, 8:00–9:00 PM

Live Roda

Experience Capoeira in its traditional setting by participating in a live roda.

During this session, we:

  • Set up the full bateria with all eight instruments used in the Capoeira roda

  • Play live Capoeira music

  • Practise singing and rhythm

  • Participate in traditional Capoeira games

The Live Roda is an excellent opportunity to build confidence, improve your musicality and experience the energy, traditions and community spirit of Capoeira.

2. BEGINNERS' CAPOEIRA COURSE

Your journey into Capoeira starts here!

Never practised Capoeira before? Our Beginners' Course is designed to introduce you to the art in a structured and supportive environment.

Over the course of one month, you will learn the essential movements, techniques and principles of Capoeira, while discovering its music, culture and traditions.

COURSE DETAILS

£140 – Complete course.

  • 8 sessions in total

  • 1 hour per session

  • 8 hours of instruction

  • Takes place over approximately one month

  • Classes on Tuesdays and Thursdays

  • Specific course dates are scheduled and published in advance

  • Suitable for complete beginners

  • No previous experience required

  • No uniform required, please wear a pair of tracksuit trousers and a t-shirt, no shorts

Course dates and scheduling

Each Beginners' Course has its own scheduled start and finish dates. The eight sessions normally take place on Tuesdays and Thursdays over approximately one month.

Please note that course dates may occasionally be adjusted to accommodate public holidays, school holidays or other scheduled closures. Any changes will be communicated to enrolled students in advance.

Please check the published dates before booking to make sure the schedule suits you.

WHAT WILL YOU LEARN?

The course introduces you to:

  • Fundamental Capoeira movements

  • Basic techniques and combinations

  • Coordination, balance and body movement

  • London School of Capoeira fundamentals

  • An introduction to Capoeira music and culture

  • The basic principles of playing in the roda

WHAT HAPPENS AFTER THE COURSE?

Once you have completed the Beginners' Course, you can progress into our regular training programme and attend the available classes.

You will then have the opportunity to develop your skills through regular Capoeira training, music sessions and live rodas.

You can choose the membership or flexible training option that best suits your goals and availability.

Important: The Beginners' Course is a separate, one-off purchase costing £140. It is not included in any of the regular memberships.

HOW TO ENROL

To join the next Beginners' Course, please book online here

  • Check the next available course dates.

  • Confirm availability.

  • Reserve your place.

  • Arrange payment of the £140 course fee.

Places should be reserved in advance.

FOUR-SESSION PASS, £135 - BOOK HERE

A flexible option for students who prefer to train without committing to a monthly membership.

ONE-TO-ONE PRIVATE LESSONS

6. JOIN THE LONDON SCHOOL OF CAPOEIRA

Capoeira is much more than a martial art. It is a combination of movement, music, culture, history and community.

At the London School of Capoeira, we aim to provide a welcoming environment where students of all backgrounds and experience levels can learn, train and develop together.

Whether your goal is to improve your fitness, learn a new skill, develop your musicality or deepen your understanding of Brazilian culture, we look forward to welcoming you.

Interested in joining us?

  • Private lessons.

We look forward to welcoming you to class!
